name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Soften your knees and hinge forward with a flat back until your arms hang below your chest.
Raise both arms out to the sides with softly bent elbows until they align with your back.
Pause briefly squeezing your upper back, then lower the dumbbells smoothly along the same arc.
tips: Keep your neck aligned with your spine and maintain a steady hinge angle.
Keep your elbow angle steady so the weights travel in wide arcs rather than toward your ribs.
